naya.summary: Separate topic intake, assessment generation, deterministic MAXESS runtime, results engine, and Naya Power handoff. AI generates structured assessment configuration; MAXESS deterministically scores it.
lessons: The generalized pipeline is TOPIC → SUBJECT SPEC → ASSESSMENT CONFIG → MAXESS RUNTIME → RESULT V1 → PERSONALIZED REPORT.
Generated assessments must be relevant, discriminating, defensible, consistent, reproducible, auditable, and explicitly scored.

human.summary: Anyone should be able to name something they want to learn, be assessed on it immediately, see where they stand, then use Naya to learn, practice, remember, reassess, and grow.
lessons: MAXESS is the measurement doorway; Naya Power is the ongoing learning relationship.
A score is a mirror, not a punishment.

evidence: Naya and Shawn versions were read in full and consolidated into one event.
